Shots fired into Champions, Minibosses, or Bosses impale them, damaging them once every 0.8 seconds for 4 seconds and creating a Vestige on each tick (6 Vestiges total).
Impaled Spikes can be stacked.
Vestigial Alchemy: Vestiges collected by Harvester Spikes charge up 'Vestigial Alchemy'.
After collecting 7 Vestiges (50% charge):
Enables a Hold [Reload] interaction that makes your next shot fired spawn a Special Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies, granting 10% of your Total Special Ammo Reserves
After collecting 17 Vestiges (100% charge):
Allows you to cycle Hold [Reload] a second time, making your next shot fired spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies on impact, granting 10% of your Total Heavy Ammo Reserves
Creating ammo bricks consumes the energy it cost to reach that level on the meter. Ammo-Spawning spikes cannot impale targets.

1.5 second cooldown between activations.

• 15% added Damage Resistance against Bosses and 85% Damage Resistance against all other Combatants
• Grants a 45 HP Void Overshield for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence) upon entry, with a 1 second cooldown before it can be granted again.
• Grants 'Stat Boost' for 10 seconds, granting ? Reload Speed, ? Handling, and 5% Increased Weapon Damage (which stacks with all other Empowering Sources)
• Benefits from Helm of Saint-14's defensive buffs.

Edge of Intent: Glaive Melee Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. Projectile Hits grant two stacks. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a sentient Healing Turret.
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.
Only applies to Glaive Projectiles.
Restorative Turret: Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a sentient Healing Turret.
Restorative Turret Properties:
• Lasts 15 seconds
• Targets you and allies within a 30 meters radius once every 3 seconds with healing orbs
• Healing orbs grant x1 Cure and x1 Restoration for 4 seconds (7 seconds with Ember of Solace) in a 7.5 meter radius
If Touch of Flame is equipped, the turret grants Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 6 seconds (9 with Ember of Solace) to the caster.

Lighting Storm occurs 0.5 seconds after the Lightning Strike and releases 4 bolts spread in an X-Pattern over the target, dealing 426 [?] damage in a 5 meter radius. Damage falls to 25% at the edge of the radius.

Telesto Bolt clusters vary by Sword Frame:
• Aggressive: 8 bolts in a clustered spread ahead of you
• Caster: 6 bolts on projectile point of impact
• Lightweight: 7 bolts in a forward arc ahead of you
• Vortex: 10 bolts spread around you
• Wave: 8 bolts at the end of the wave

Landing 5 Sword Hits causes a Solar Explosion dealing 237 [64] damage and applying 40 Scorch (60 Scorch with Ember of Ashes) in a 5 meter radius.
Wolfpack Rounds: Light attacks spawn 1 Wolfpack Round.
Grounded Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Pack Hunter' to you and allies in a ? meter radius for 10 seconds.
Pack Hunter buffs all Ergo Sum and Non-Exotic Swords. Pack Hunter causes sword swings to release 3 tracking submunitions that deal 90 [33] damage each.
Wolfpack Rounds count as sword hits, and can benefit from both sword perks and Empowering buffs.

Light Attacks on Sacred-Flame marked targets, or on target death, trigger an explosion dealing 136 [?] damage in a 5 meter radius.
Sacred Flame does not recieve the Ergo Sum Transcendence damage buff.
Insectoid Robot Grenades: Kills spawn a seeking Insectoid Robot that hunts enemies. Detonates for 284 [?] damage on impact in a 3 meter radius.
Gathering Light: Sword Kills grants 1 stack of 'Gathering Light'. Maximum of 10 stacks.
Gathering Light benefits at 1|2|3|...|10 Stacks:
• ? Guard Resistance
• ? Guard Endurance
• 10%|20%|30%|...|100% increased lunge distance
Stowing the sword consumes all stacks, granting 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability energy per stack.
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
Arc Conductor: Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Arc Conductor' for 6 seconds.
While Arc Conductor is active, gain 50% [15%] Damage Resistance to Arc Damage and emit chain lightning around you in a 12 meter radius every 0.25 seconds, dealing 171 [26] damage per tick. On single targets, a bonus second tick triggers every 1.5 seconds.
Lightning is treated as sword damage.
Buff is removed on stow.
Transcendent Duelist: Kills grant an additional 2.5% energy to both Light and Dark Transcendence bars.
While Transcendent, gain the following benefits:
• 44% increased sword damage (Exotic Perk effects are instead granted 20% increased damage)
• Dealing sword damage increases Transcendence Grenade Regeneration by 35% for 2 seconds
• Kills extend your Transcendence duration by an additional ? seconds

Guidance Rings grant their benefits to any Combat Bow, including Legendaries, Exotics, Heavy Crossbows, Shadowshot, and also Buried Bloodline.
Arrows fired by Hierarchy of Needs release three seekers, while most other bows release two. Casting Shadowshot: Deadfall releases six.

Transmutation Spheres are considered a generic 'Void Weapon'. They benefit from Empowering and Void-Verb Buffs, but are unaffected by nor trigger Ability, Trace Rifle, or Weapon Surge effects.
Evolution: Transmutation Spheres act like Relics and grant three actions. Spheres last 30 seconds once on the ground, start with 30 ammo on pickup, and drain at a rate of 1 ammo per second. Dropping a Sphere despawns it.
• Light Attacks deal 270 [150] damage, disorient combatants, and cost 1 ammo. You can attack twice per second. Airborne attacks deal 25% reduced damage.

• Guarding projects a draining field in a 5 meter radius around you. The field disorients enemies, deals 28 [12] damage every 0.3 seconds to lifesteal 5 HP, and grants 80% [50%] damage resistance along with knockback immunity.
Guarding drains 1 ammo every 0.25 seconds, slowing at 3 ammo and halting on the final round. Guarding at 1 ammo deals increasingly lethal self-damage every 0.7 seconds until you stop or die.

entries.name: Symmetry
entries.inGame:
Revolution: Hold [Reload] to activate Arc Seeker mode.
Arc Seeker Mode reduces Fire Rate to 100 RPM and shoots tracking bolts that deal 76 [50] damage in a 3 meter radius.
Special Note:
Bolt Charge that is discharged through Arc Seeker hits counts as 'Scout Rifle Weapon Damage' and benefits from all increases that apply to this damage type. This allows the Bolt Charge detonations to scale both with traditional weapon damage buffs (like Radiant and Surges) and with Combatant Scalars.
Furthermore, hits that would discharge Bolt Charge anyway (such as hits behind a Storm's Keep barricade or hits as the caster of a Well of Radiance) cause Bolt Charge to discharge twice, with one buffed as weapon damage and the other being a regular discharge.
This damage increase to Bolt Charge can be further compounded by the Flashover Artifact Mod from the Tablet of Ruin, which adds a multiplicative 50%.
Dynamic Charge: Precision Hits and Kills grant one stack of 'Dynamic Charge'. Maximum of 15 stacks.
Holding [Reload] refills the magazine based on the number of stacks and converts them into 'Revolution' stacks. Switching modes again removes all stacks.

Arc Seekers also gain a non-linear increase to their splash radius, granting 33%|233% increased splash radius at x10|x20 Stacks (up to 4|7 meters in radius).
While Revolution's timer is active, Arc Seekers generate x2 Bolt Charge for each hit and gain the ability to discharge Bolt Charge stacks. At or above 10 stacks of Revolution, hits generate x3 Bolt Charge.
Bolt Charge generation is unaffected by Spark of Frequency.
Review this exotic's intrinsic perk to learn a special note about the Bolt Charge behavior from this gun.

(15% of Magazine, rounded down) + 1
Swords and GLs: 2
3-Ammo Snipers: 1

Gaining a Bolt Charge stack grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack obtained, generally granting 25% Melee Ability Energy over the 10 stacks needed to discharge.
Acquiring over x10 stacks through abilities will still grant the corresponding Ability Gains (For example, being at x9 and acquiring x4 will still grant 10% Melee Energy)

After 0.5 seconds of scoring an Ability Hit or dealing Unpowered Melee Damage while at x10 Bolt Charge stacks:
Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy, dealing up to 405 Bolt Splash + 270 Ground Splash = 675 Total [36 Bolt Splash + 30 Ground Splash] Arc Damage over ? meters.
Does not count as Ability Damage, only as Generic Arc Damage.

Volatile Explosions | Freeze Shatter (Not auto-shatter on Bosses) | Tangle Explosions | Threadlings | Unraveling Threads | Suspend Snap on Bosses | Forerunner's The Rock

Do NOT trigger Discharge:
Jolt's Chain Lightning | Scorch and Ignitions (from Non-Abilities) | Crystal Shatter (from Non-Abilities) | Gifted Conviction's Explosives

Continuously restores health. Effect is uninterruptible and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default.
x1 = 35 [17.5] HP/s | x2 = 50 [25] HP/s

Reapplying Restoration will refresh its duration to its longest achieved duration, keeping the highest Restoration stack.

Using a Phoenix Dive after using a Healing Grenade will refresh its duration to 4+2 seconds.
Empyrean and Mercy are both duration extenders, and do not count as reapplying Restoration. Extending a Solar Effect that is at >15 seconds will set it to 15 seconds.

2.7 + (0.175 * Scorch Stacks) | Non-Boss Combatants receive 20% increased damage.
x1 = 3 | x30 = 5 | x50 = 6.5 | x60 = 7.21 | x80 = 8.64 | Scorch Damage is non-lethal.

entries.name: Solar Effect Damage Scaling
entries.inGame:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.

Inflicting a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent/Burning Ambition or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as other Damage Perks, Weapon Stat, Radiant, and Solar Weapon Surges.
New Gear Bonus is applied permanently to all Weapons, so all Solar Effect Damage against Combatants will always be 5% higher than expected, on top of Combatant Rank Scalars.

Inflicting Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs and 100+ Melee Stat do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries.inGame:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were.

Offensive Actions: Instantly ends Invisibility
Shooting | Grenade, Melee, Super, or Blink Ability Usage | Barricade or Rift Placement | Vehicle Summon

Loud Actions: Pings Radar | Combatants Track
Beginning Sprint | Non-Blink Movement Ability Usage | Hunter Class Ability Usage

Stability, Handling, Reload Speed and Recoil Direction are decreased by 75%.

Eg: 160 Reload Speed will be reduced be 40 Reload Speed. 80 Handling would be reduced to 20 Handling.

Frozen Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants and Guardians receive 120% increased Basic Melee and Glaive Melee Attack Damage, on top of the aforementioned effects.

Frozen Enemies shatter after receiving varying [200] damage.

Frozen Enemies are immobilized for 6 [1.35 to 4.75] seconds.
Boss Combatants are unhindered by freeze and automatically shatter after 3 seconds.
Grounded Guardians can cast their Super Ability to instantly break out.

Brief Freeze:
Guardians frozen by other Guardians are frozen for 1.35 seconds

Prolonged Freeze:
Guardians that become frozen by Combatants, or by Stasis Super Abilities, are frozen for 4.75 seconds.
Frozen Guardians have their Class Ability replaced with Breakout, which allows breaking out of the long-lasting freeze, in exchange for ? Health.
Guardians that are frozen during a Roaming Super automatically break out after a second, while One-off Supers get deactivated if frozen during the cast animation.

Construct with ? HP that can exist for up to 20 seconds before dissipating.

entries.name: Transcendence

Unique ability obtained upon utilizing enough Light and Darkness damage types.
Kinetic Damage fills both Light and Darkness bars at 50% decreased rate. Overkill Damage isn't counted for Transcendence gains.
Having one full Alignment bar makes Kinetic Damage fill the remaining bar with at 40% decreased rate.

Dealing damage, alongside applying Elemental Effects grants Transcendence Energy.
Applying Elemental Effects, both buffs and debuffs, grant Transcendence Energy to their corresponding alignment.

Transcendence:
Instantly recharges 2 Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on activation.
Replaces Grenade Ability with an unique class-specific Prismatic Grenade Ability with Light and Darkness damage types.
Grants 5% Increased Weapon Damage, an additional 10% Grenade and Melee Regeneration Speed, and 20% [5%] Damage Resist for 20 seconds.
Damage Increase stacks with everything.

Dealing Grenade Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Melee Regeneration Speed to 35% Fixed Melee Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.
Dealing Melee Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Prismatic Grenade Regeneration Speed to 35% Prismatic Grenade Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.

Kills while Transcendent extend its duration, with the amount extended decreasing as more kills are scored.
Tier 1 and T2 Combatants = 5% | T3 and T4 = 10% | T3 Elites, Minibosses and Bosses = 15% | Guardians = ?%
Each kill after the first gets a cumulative 0.9?x penalty to the duration extension.

entries.name: Elemental Effects
entries.inGame:
Elemental Effects include all of the verbs that subclasses apply that can either positively (Buff) or negatively (Debuff) affect a target.

Equipping any Arc Ability or Aspect allows Amplified to be activated by scoring multiple Arc Kills. Thruster does not count as an Arc Ability.
Equipping any Strand Ability or Aspect allows the creation of Tangles, and Warlocks are able to possess Perched Threadlings.

Arc = ↑Amplified ↑Bolt Charge ↓Blind ↓Jolt | Ionic Trace
Solar = ↑Cure ↑Radiant ↑Restoration ↓Scorch ↓Ignition | Firesprites
Void = ↑Devour ↑Invisibility ↑Void Overshield ↓Suppression ↓Volatile ↓Weaken | Void Breach

Darkness Subclass Verbs:
Stasis = ↑Frost Armor ↓Slow ↓Freeze ↓Shatter | Stasis Shards

Your barricade slides 20 meters forward upon cast. Enemies that come into contact with your barricade take a burst of damage and recieve 20 Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes). Contact Damage can only trigger once every 2 seconds on the same enemy, and your barricade loses the ability to disorient. Shieldburst passively charges in strength at a rate of 34% per second.
Rally Barricade:
Your barricade grants Scorch Rounds to your Solar and Kinetic weapons. Scorch applied and rate of application varies between weapon archetypes. Shieldburst passively charges in strenth at a rate of 10% per second.

entries.inGame:

Holding [Grenade] charges your grenade ability over the span of ? seconds and enhances it once thrown.
Enhanced Behaviors:
• Axion Bolt gains 2 additional seekers, travels ?% further, deals 25% increased damage, and retriggers again 1 second after landing
• Scatter Grenade gains 4 additional submunitions, aggressively seeks targets within 5 meters, and deals 25% increased damage against Combatants
• Vortex Grenade gains 70% increased radius, 7.5% increased duration, pulls targets in and begins its damage 0.2 seconds sooner, and continously retriggers its pull every ? seconds
• Magnetic, Spike, Suppressor, and Voidwall Grenade become a 'Handheld Supernova' and release a short-range blast of 9 high damage projectiles. Projectiles travel up to 12.5 meters away and apply Volatile on hit. Passively grants 15% increased Grenade Regeneration Speed

entries.name: Child of the Old Gods
entries.inGame:
Casting your Rift grants a 'Void Soul' for 25 seconds.
Weapon Hits send the Void Soul towards the target's location, projecting a 10 meter radius Weakening field upon arrival that lasts for 9.25 seconds. Void Soul continously deals damage and applies Weaken every 0.7 seconds. The  Weaken lasts for 4 [2.5] seconds after its last application. For the first 4 [?] seconds of being tethered, targets are Suppressed as well.
If you have Healing Rift equipped, the Void Soul grants 4% Grenade and Melee Energy every other tick. If you have Empowering Rift equipped, the Void Soul grants 25 HP every other tick.
Defeating targets within Void Soul's radius grant Class Ability Energy based on Combatant Tier:
• Tier 1: 10%
• Tier 2: 15%
• Tier 3: 20%
• Tier 4 or 5: 50%
• Players: 33.3%
Void Soul counts as a Grenade Ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-specific effects.
entries.inCalculator: Active in a window that the rotation opens.

entries.name: Feed the Void

Ability kills grant Devour for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence). (Prismatic Only: Kills with Shatter, Volatile Explosions, and Tangles also grant Devour).
Your Devour is enhanced, granting twice as much HP (70HP🠚140 HP) and Grenade Ability Energy.
Kills while Devour is active add 5 seconds to the timer (8 with Echo of Persistence).
Enhanced Devour Grenade Energy granted is based on Combatant Tier:
• Tier 1: 15%
• Tier 2: 23.2%
• Tier 3: 27.5%
• Tier 4 or Players: 40%

entries.name: Soul Siphon

Dealing damage with Pocket Singularity grants 'Soul Siphon Ready' for 20 seconds, replacing your melee ability with Soul Siphon.
[Melee Input] while Soul Siphon is readied to tether up to four enemies within 20 meters in front of you, granting 15 HP of Void Overshield for 15 seconds (23 seconds with Echo of Persistence) per tick of damage.
Soul Siphon deals 8 ticks of increasingly higher melee damage over 3.2 seconds and restores ?% Class Ability energy per tick.
At the end of the drain, Soul Siphon triggers a final burst of damage that staggers any surviving combatants.

entries.name: Bleak Watcher
entries.inGame:
Base Grenade Cooldown is set to 121 seconds while equipped.
Holding [Grenade] charges your grenade and converts it into a throwable 'Stasis Turret' that targets enemies within a 35 meter radius.
Stasis Turret fires a burst of 5 seeking projectiles over 0.7 seconds every 2 seconds. Each projectile applies x20 [x10] Slow for 4.5 [2] seconds on hit (9 [3.75] seconds with Whisper of Durance).
Turret lasts for 25 seconds (30 seconds with Whisper of Durance) and has 67% Damage Resistance until it has fired.
Stasis Turret counts as a Grenade Ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-specific effects.

Casting your Class Ability instantly Freezes enemies within an 8.5 [5] meter radius and increases Melee Lunge Distance by 2.5 meters for 1.2 seconds. Enemy Players within 5 to 8 meters receive x50 Slow stacks for 3? seconds.
Successfully freezing a target with this ability grants x5 Frost Armor.

entries.name: Glacial Harvest

• Small Stasis Shards grant x1 Frost Armor, 10% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 10 HP.
• Large Stasis Shards grant x3 Frost Armor, 50% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 20 HP.
While Frost Armor is active:
• Kinetic and Stasis Weapon Kills have an escalating chance to trigger a Stasis Shatter based on the number of Frost Armor stacks.
• Taking damage grants ?% Grenade Ability energy (once per second).
Intrinsic to All Stasis Subclasses:
Stasis Shards are generated by:
• Shattering a Frozen target or Stasis Crystal
• Defeating a Stasis-Debuffed (Slowed or Frozen) target
Minor combatants generate a small Stasis Crystal, while Elites, Minibosses, and Guardians generate a Large Stasis Crystal.
In PvP Only:
Stasis Shards go on a 10 second cooldown upon creating 6 shards within ? seconds of the first.

Iceflare Bolts incur an 8 second cooldown upon creating 7 [1] Seekers within ? seconds of each other.

• Shackle Grenade can be consumed by holding [Grenade], granting 'Weaver's Trance' for 25 seconds. Kills while Weaver's Trance is active trigger a ? meter radius explosion around the target that Suspends enemies for 6? seconds
• Slicewire Grenade can be charged by holding [Grenade] to drop 4 additional explosion submunitions, and ends with the creation of a Tangle (ignores global cooldowns)

Shooting a Tangle creates a delayed explosion that detonates after ? seconds, Suspending all enemies hit for 7 seconds.
Thrown Tangles are unaffected by gravity and aggressively seek targets, attaching to them and detonating after ? seconds. These detonations Suspend enemies in a ? meter radius for 7 seconds.

entries.name: Weavewalk
entries.inGame:
While Airborne with at least one full Melee Charge, pressing [Air Move] activates Weavewalk and consumes 20% Melee Ability Energy.
While Weavewalk is active, your Melee Energy drains at a rate of 25% per second, and you generate a Perched Threadling every 0.5 seconds.
Weavewalk grants 90% Damage Resistance against Combatants and Players, and functionally grants the effects of Void Invisibility, preventing enemy combatants from engaging you.
You are unable to interact with the world while Weavewalk is active. This includes reviving other Players, collecting ammo bricks, or picking up Orbs of Power. Threadlings, Arc Souls, and No Time To Explain's 'Time-Slip Portal' deal 50% decreased damage while Weavewalk is active.
Exiting Weavewalk grants Woven Mail based on the duration it was active, granting 2 to 20 seconds of Woven Mail.

• Minors, Elites, and Minibosses: 33%
• Players: 67%
• Bosses: 100%
Casting your Class Ability creates three Threadlings and simultaneously deploys all Perched Threadlings.
Threadlings grant 10% Class Ability Energy per hit.
